name: team-shopify
description: Add-on team for Shopify store repos (e.g. smartwatchbanden): the subagents Liam, Sandra, and Steven, plus the domain skill start-task (new branch + preview theme). Deliberately NOT repo-neutral — only a Shopify repo enables this team. Teams stack: this one adds to 'team-alpha', and a commercial Shopify repo typically enables 'team-ecomm' alongside it. The governance layer (CLAUDE.md + the repo lenses) stays separate.
